verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server and shows agents shipping feature flags from a prompt ("your agents can ship a feature flag from a prompt"), plus an OpenAPI-documented REST API, and feature-flag targeting by property/cohort/group is well documented. Missing for 10: explicit MCP tool-level documentation of toggle/target operations beyond creation, and independent hands-on confirmation of flag-specific MCP workflows (community evidence only touches LLM/cohort issues, not flags).
